lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters are arranged in approximately 10 visible vertical columns along the lateral flank. The centroids in the posterior (right) section exhibit larger diameters and greater inter-blob spacing compared to the smaller, more densely packed clusters in the anterior (left) section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular centroids, forming a semi-regular grid pattern most observable in the central and posterior regions of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with light pixels on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregularly shaped region of elevated luminance is present on the dorsal-lateral surface in the upper-left quadrant, disrupting the standard circular spot pattern.
